scientific_integrity: Exact source geometry and zero-speed uniqueness are credited. Uniform positive-launch asymptotics and branch-selection theorem are assessed as new. Deterministic numerical checks supplement an analytical proof, with no assertion of independent certification.
scientific_limitations: Applies to frictionless, nonspinning radius-rho spheres launched outward from the exact apex of a fixed generalized Norton dome with exponent a>1, locally before a small contact arclength; no claim for arbitrary shapes, noise laws, rolling contact, or uniformity in exponent. The 2026 source supplies baseline geometry and exact-rest results. Prior literature may contain implicit equivalents; independent audit is absent.
title: Exponentially small launches select every delayed Norton trajectory in the finite-sphere limit
